detail.longDescription: Using CMake for my new C project (I'm encoding my card game in computer form for ease of development). CMake is cursed but wrangles some complexity so I don't have to. I'm using VSCodium since it does debugging and has a decent Vim mode. It's an alright dev setup. I just don't have extra hours and days to spend getting the perfect set up. Needless to say, I have been writing code by hand, which is satisfying. Turns out, I still enjoy # programming . # C # SDL # CMake # VSCodium
